context: External synthetic CyberSand-like host; no native/Workbench code changed

training.method: online cross-entropy imitation with DAgger-style roll-in; frozen 23-feature base and learned 12-feature additive adapter

findings: All 53 frozen-greedy failed tasks and all 52 adapter-greedy failed tasks contained exactly one painted non-target starting cell, consuming the last ink allowance.
At equal frozen checkpoint and greedy decoder, model-side refusal of paint paths crossing known starting cell changed completion from 91/144 to 144/144; paired wins/losses 53/0.
At equal adapted checkpoint and greedy decoder, START guard changed completion from 92/144 to 144/144; paired wins/losses 52/0.
Route-specific new adapter features contributed 1/144 additional greedy completion relative to same adapted checkpoint with those extra features masked, an inconclusive gain.
Without START guard, greedy decoding improved frozen policy over stochastic decoding by 35 matched completions, with paired wins/losses 36/1.
Guarded stochastic policies remained incomplete: frozen 92/144 and adapter 117/144.
The GAL-012 apparent branch-recovery deficit was materially confounded by painting a known non-goal START cell: 71 of 120 frozen failures included one off-goal ink.
